headline: Weathered Expanse Balance Shifts as Mooring County Fights On
war_summary: The newest dispatches mark a turn in the Weathered Expanse, where the footing now reads four Warden posts against three Colonial and two in ruin — a swing toward the Warden mark since our last edition — after ninety-one actions in the day, Wightwalk alone drawing thirty-five, and Warden casualties, near eleven thousand, again the heavier. Mooring County grants no respite: fifty-five base actions, MacConmara Barrows and the Wind Hills the busiest points, its ledger now seven Warden, four Colonial and one ruin, with two-hour losses near fifteen hundred. Callahan's Passage, so hot through yesterday, has fallen silent since evening, as has Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua. Fresh thunder instead at Pari Peak's Little Raakkua before dawn, and at Stlican Shelf's Breaker Town and Briar scarcely an hour past. The Nevish Line continues to exact a heavy, mounting toll on both hosts. Day 565 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
